correctness.rationale: Fix M≥2, R_M=lim Z/M^n, D_M(r+Mq)=q(M+r), k=φ(M). Every M+r (r unit) is invertible. Inverse branches F_r(y)=r+My/(M+r) are exact 1/M similarities and land in distinct residue cylinders, yielding a conjugacy K_M≃U_M^N. k^n equal-radius balls give entropy log k, Haar measure ≤(k/M)^n→0, and the Bernoulli mass-distribution/cylinder-cover inequalities give exactly H^{log k/log M}=1; M=2 is correctly treated as a singleton. Fixed points of shift^n number k^n, and Mobius inversion gives least-period orbit count. Affine inverse composition gives the stated rational formula; F_r([M,2M])⊂(M,2M) proves no integer a≥2M can have an eventually periodic non-dropping itinerary. Independently evaluated all M=2..10 and period words n≤3 with k^n distinct rational fixed points in (M,2M), correct residues and unit denominators. These tests corroborate, not replace, the all-modulus argument.
